notes: ARCHIVE-SOURCED. Huawei has delisted the Mate X5: consumer.huawei.com/en/phones/mate-x5/specs/ returns HTTP 404 and the China URL now 302-redirects to the phone listing. Every value here comes from Huawei's own China pages via web.archive.org - spec page snapshot 2023-09-11, product page snapshot 2023-09-29 - which the spec counts as primary. Chinese translations: "长度 156.9 mm 宽度 折叠态：72.4 mm 展开态：141.5 mm 厚度 折叠态：11.08 mm 展开态：5.3 mm" = "Length 156.9 mm; Width folded 72.4 mm, unfolded 141.5 mm; Thickness folded 11.08 mm, unfolded 5.3 mm". "重量 素皮版：约 243 g（含电池） 羽砂版：约 245 g（含电池）" = "Weight: vegan-leather version approx. 243 g (including battery); Feather Sand version approx. 245 g (including battery)". "尺寸 外屏：6.4 英寸 内屏：7.85 英寸" = "Size: outer screen 6.4 inches, inner screen 7.85 inches". "分辨率 外屏：2504 × 1080 像素 内屏：2496 × 2224 像素" = "Resolution: outer screen 2504 x 1080 pixels, inner screen 2496 x 2224 pixels". "外屏：3D 四曲 OLED，支持 1-120 Hz LTPO 自适应刷新率" = "Outer screen: 3D quad-curved OLED supporting a 1-120 Hz LTPO adaptive refresh rate"; the inner screen is "可折叠柔性 OLED" supporting up to 120 Hz. "玻璃类型 ... 昆仑玻璃 ... 典藏版：玄武钢化昆仑玻璃" = "Glass type: Kunlun Glass; Collector's Edition: Basalt-tempered Kunlun Glass". "创新双旋水滴铰链 超轻薄，超可靠，稳悬停。" = "Innovative dual-rotation water-drop hinge - ultra-thin, ultra-reliable, stable hovering." "幻影紫，质感素皮 ... 羽砂白，抗指纹羽砂工艺，优雅纯净。" = "Mystic Purple, textured vegan leather ... Feather Sand White, anti-fingerprint Feather Sand process, elegant and pure." Only ONE folded thickness is published (11.08 mm) so depth_at_hinge is null. TWO masses are published, split by back finish (243 g / 245 g); the larger (245 g, Feather Sand version) is recorded and both are quoted. Huawei's footnote states the folded thickness excludes the camera module and the unfolded thickness excludes the screen border and camera module. The inner-screen refresh rate is version-dependent on the same page (12 GB model "up to 120 Hz"; 16 GB and Collector's Edition "1-120 Hz LTPO adaptive"); 120 is the stated maximum for all. These dimensions are identical to the Mate X3's - that is NOT a carry-over: both were read independently from their own Huawei spec pages (Huawei reused the chassis). Height (长度) 156.9 mm is published as one value for both states. materials.frame null: the China page describes only a "超轻凹形机身结构" ("ultra-light concave body structure") and names no frame material. Display aspect ratios are not published - left null; PPI 426 is published but active_area_mm is left null because Huawei states the diagonals are standard-rectangle measurements with a slightly smaller actual viewing area. resolution_px recorded in Huawei's printed order (long axis first). microsd port = Huawei's proprietary NM card slot, recorded under the nearest allowed kind. announced/released null: no manufacturer page carrying a launch date was found; the September 2023 dates appear only on excluded secondary sources. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
